records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The impact of COVID-19 was a significant contributing factor for the year ended December 31, 2020, which resulted in decreases in net revenue in foreign countries as a group.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: By March 2020, the U.S. economy had been largely shut down by mass quarantines and government mandated stay-in-place orders (the “Orders”) to halt the spread of the virus.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2021, the Direct / Social Selling segment also had a non-recurring charge to cost of goods sold of $0.5 million that related to the sale of inventories acquired as part of the Ariix business combination.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of goods sold increased from $22.2 million for the three months ended March 31, 2020 to $38.1 million for the three months ended March 31, 2021, an increase of $15.9 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2021, we incurred a net loss of $19.5 million and cash used in our operating activities amounted to $2.1 million.
